common.tier_subline: {tier_long} · roughly the {pct}th percentile of the reference distribution
common.suppressed_low_confidence: Not measured on this capture — the landmarks here weren't confident enough. A retake in brighter, even light usually resolves it.
common.suppressed_occluded: Not measured — something was covering this area. Hair, glasses or a hand will do it.
common.suppressed_not_shipped: This measurement didn't meet our reliability bar, so we don't show it.
onboarding.start_body: Guided capture, on-device geometry, published reference ranges. The same face gets the same number. Nothing leaves your phone.
onboarding.goals_title: What do you want out of this?
onboarding.goals_body: Pick up to three, in order. Your plan is built from these and from what we measure.
onboarding.about_title: Two things the reference ranges depend on
onboarding.about_body: Published facial norms are reported by sex and by age. These are the only two things we ask, and they only select which reference table you're compared against.
onboarding.about_age_attest: I confirm I am 18 or older.
onboarding.about_under18: This app is for adults. You can come back when you're 18.
onboarding.time_body: Per day. The plan is cut to fit this. A plan you keep beats a plan you admire.
onboarding.time_footnote: Bigger items like training and fat loss are counted as one daily check-in, not their full duration.
consent.title: Before the first capture
consent.body_1: We're about to measure your face. Here is exactly what happens.
consent.point_captured: Captured: ten frames from the front camera and, if you choose, a profile. Depth data from the TrueDepth sensor is used for distance and head angle.
consent.point_processed: Processed on this phone. The images, depth data and face landmarks never leave the device and are deleted the moment the measurements are computed.
consent.point_retained: Kept on this phone: the measurements themselves — named numbers like a canthal tilt of 4°. Nothing a face could be rebuilt or matched from.
consent.point_cloud: Optional, separate, off by default: syncing those numbers to your account so history survives a new phone.
consent.point_delete: Deleting everything is one tap in Settings. Local data is wiped immediately; anything synced is permanently deleted within 30 days.
consent.point_policy: Our biometric data policy says all of this in full, including retention and destruction timelines.
consent.affirm_label: I consent to {app_name} measuring my face on this device as described.
consent.decline_body: Without this, the app can't measure anything. Your account stays; nothing is captured.
consent.cloud_toggle_body: Numbers only. Off by default. Revocable any time.
consent.state_block_title: Not available where you are yet
consent.state_block_body: We don't offer face measurement to residents of Illinois, Texas or Washington at the moment. Everything else in the app works.
capture.hint_yaw: Turn your head to face the camera
capture.hint_lighting_uneven: Face the light — one side is darker
capture.hint_clipping: Too bright — move out of direct light
capture.hint_occlusion: Clear hair and glasses from your face
capture.profile_hint_turn: Turn until only one eye is visible
capture.profile_hint_ear: We need to see your ear and the corner of your eye
capture.shutter_disabled_note: Capture starts on its own once every check passes
capture.aborted_body: {gate} drifted during capture. Nothing was saved. Try again — it takes a few seconds.
capture.skip_profile_note: Profile measurements will show as needing a capture. You can add it later from Settings.
processing.title: Measuring
processing.footnote: Happening on this phone. Your capture is deleted as soon as this finishes.
reveal.what_it_is: A measured comparison against published population norms, weighted by how strong the evidence behind each measurement is.
results.title: Results
results.swipe_hint: Swipe through one measurement at a time
results.free_locked_note: Measured on this capture. Open with Pro.
results.free_improvable_label: Your most improvable measurement, and one thing to do about it
results.model_changed_title: Your score moved because the model changed, not because your face did
results.model_changed_body: We updated the scoring model from {old} to {new}. Your stored measurements were re-scored on this phone. Here is the change and the reason for it.
results.no_profile_note: Profile measurements need a profile capture.
metric_detail.reliability_B: Measured to within 5% across sessions, shown as a range
metric_detail.reliability_C: Shown as a category — not precise enough for a number
metric_detail.fwhr_explainer: The community treats a higher ratio as desirable. A 2015 meta-analysis across fourteen samples found the opposite association with rated attractiveness. We show it because you expect it; it carries no weight in the score.
metric_detail.community_explainer: No clinical norm exists for this. The reference range is the community's convention, and the score weight is capped near zero.
metric_detail.beard_note: Facial hair reduces how precisely the jaw and chin can be located. This reading is shown with wider uncertainty.
metric_detail.schematic_note: Schematic face. Your numbers, not your photo.
metric_detail.geometry_note: Your measured geometry from this capture. Not stored.
paywall.title: Pro
paywall.intro: The score you have is the real one. Pro opens the rest of the measurement.
paywall.includes_1: All {n} measurements with values and reference ranges
paywall.includes_2: Measurement overlays drawn on your own face geometry
paywall.includes_5: Week 4 and week 8 re-scans with deltas
paywall.renewal_terms: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Cancel any time in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions. The trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.
today.title: Today
today.week_banking: {days} of 5 days to bank this week
today.scan_open_body: Enough time has passed for the measurements to have moved. Same light, same time of day as last time if you can.
today.scan_locked_why: Scans are at weeks 4 and 8 because the things the plan changes take that long to show in a measurement. Earlier scans would mostly measure lighting.
today.empty_title: Your plan starts with a scan
today.empty_body: The plan is built from what we measure. One capture, a few seconds.
today.quiet_checkin_body: If you're finding yourself checking this a lot, that's worth paying attention to. Appearance preoccupation is common and treatable. If it's weighing on you, talking to someone helps — 988 connects you to support any time.
streak.save_body: One repair a month bridges a single missed day. You have this month's.
streak.save_unavailable_body: This month's repair is used. The streak starts again from today; banked weeks stay banked.
plan.title: Plan
plan.intro: Built from your measurements and your goals.
plan.professional_footer: We don't recommend procedures or prescriptions and we have no financial relationship with any provider.
plan.regenerated_note: Your plan is rebuilt from each new scan.
journey.title: Path
journey.intro: Eight weeks. A week banks at five of seven days. Scans at weeks four and eight.
journey.finish_body: Both scans done. Your deltas are in Progress. Want to go again? The plan rebuilds from the week-8 scan.
progress.title: Progress
progress.model_note: Scores are comparable across scans only on the same model version. Changes marked with a version are model changes, not face changes.
progress.empty_body: Your first delta arrives with the week-4 scan.
share.title: Share
share.photo_warning: Your capture leaves the device only if you choose to include it, and only in the image you share.
methodology.title: How this works
methodology.what_the_score_is: A measured comparison against published population norms, weighted by how strong the evidence behind each measurement is, expressed as a percentile of a sex-matched reference distribution. 0–10 is that percentile divided by ten.
methodology.what_it_is_not: It is not a claim about objective attractiveness. About half of what makes a face appealing to any specific person is personal taste no measurement captures. We don't rate you against other users of this app.
methodology.capture_body: The shutter stays disabled until head angle is within 3°, distance is 45–75 cm, lighting is even, expression is neutral and nothing covers the face. Ten frames are captured and the median is used; the spread across frames becomes part of your confidence band. A phone at arm's length makes a nose read about thirty percent wider than it is — the distance gate exists because of that.
methodology.metrics_body: Each measurement is a pure function of landmark positions, with a published reference range and a citation. Each carries two independent labels: how reliably we can measure it, and how strong the evidence is that it matters. A measurement can be precise and still carry no weight.
methodology.score_body: Measurements that research supports carry weight. Measurements the community cares about but research doesn't support are shown and carry almost none. Facial width-to-height ratio is shown and carries none, because the evidence points the other way. A measurement also carries less weight the noisier it is relative to how much people actually differ on it — a number we can read to 2% but on which faces only differ by 1.5% cannot tell you much, and the score treats it that way. The weighting is a published judgement, not a calibration against human ratings.
methodology.band_body: 'Likely 5.0–7.8' is the range we expect your score to land in if you scanned again. It combines how much your measurements moved across the ten frames, how much each measurement is known to move between sessions, and a fixed allowance for the weighting itself. A wide band is the honest state of the measurement, not a fault; it narrows as our session-to-session data improves. It is never narrower than ±0.15.
methodology.tiers_body: LTN below the 45th percentile · MTN 45–65 · HTN 65–85 · Chadlite 85–97 · Chad 97 and above. There is no tier below LTN.
methodology.reference_body: Mostly Farkas's anthropometric norms, plus the clinical aesthetic literature for profile angles. Where ancestry changes a norm — canthal tilt, nasal angles — we use the pooled value with a wider band until stratified data lands. Ancestry is never a feature that can move a score down.
methodology.privacy_body: Images, depth data and landmarks are processed and deleted on this phone. Only named measurements are kept, and they're synced only if you turn that on. We run a network audit before each release and publish the trace.
methodology.versions_body: Scoring model {version}. When the model changes, stored measurements are re-scored on your phone and the app tells you your score moved because the model did.
methodology.reliability_target_body: We measure how much the same person's score moves between sessions and publish the figure. Our release gate is a median session-to-session score standard deviation of 0.6 points or less; the band you see is sized to that measured noise, so a re-scan should land inside it about two times in three.
settings.title: You
settings.consent_revoke_body: The app will stop measuring. Existing measurements stay until you delete them.
settings.delete_body: Wipes all measurements, plan and history from this phone now, and permanently deletes anything synced within 30 days. Your sign-in is tombstoned; signing in again starts fresh.
